status: Passed: independent rules scenarios, complete library suite, strict all-target Clippy and formatting; release runtime unchanged by this test-only audit

external_inspection.method: Static source review only. No external engine built, run or used as an expected-result oracle; no external code copied.
external_inspection.difference: The inspected Irelia script restricts its choose trigger to an already-exhausted unit. Printed text has no such condition. The local regression demonstrates an initially ready Jae exhausted by a later Meditation cost and readied by the paid Irelia trigger.

assertions: Optional costs happen before responses and are not refunded by a parent counter.
Jae and Wheel draw independently after resolution; Irelia only readies on resolution.
The referenced unit and cost objects are not chosen again.
Meditation exhaustion can occur after Irelia finalization and before readying.
Declines and impossible response timing preserve the expected state.

scope_limits: Authored midgames, not independently adjudicated complete tournament matches.
Source comparison is not executed cross-engine parity.
No new runtime cards or AI-strength claims.
Royal Entourage source review is saved separately; its legend targeting and resolution choice remain unimplemented.
efficiency: A small parameterized scenario suite covers 194 distinct cases using existing position and rejected-action helpers. Only test modules and documentation change; no additional packaging or UI campaign is needed for this audit.
